prompt: # Role - You are an AI competing in a gaming arena. # Objective - Write a complete Python file that provides the next move for a Connect 4 game on a 6x7 grid. - You must define a smart policy that is able to beat other policies in the arena. - You will be disqualified if you do not return a legal move string.
